incident-bot: INCIDENT: high tail latency detected on api-prod (shard-7). p95 up 3x, p99 > 10s. KV cache pressure + eviction burst. Paging oncall @Maria. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/latency?shard=7 :rotating_light:
Maria (oncall): Oncall ack. I'm looking. Anyone see recent deploys to runtime?
ops-bot: Deploys: none in last 2h. Autoscaler events: a few scale-ups on shard-7 prefill pool. Eviction rate spike at 2026-03-15T21:08:12Z.
Alex (sre): I can see a large prefill queue backlog on prefill-worker-7. Prefill > decode throughput. p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~12.4s for streaming endpoints. Streaming stalls reported at token positions ~3-8. KV fragment count high on node.
Jin (eng-runtime): That matches local traces — prefill tasks piling up holding KV locks, decoder can't get KVs quickly -> stalls. Likely fragmentation + uneven shard allocation.
Maria (oncall): Okay, mitigation plan: 1) throttle/disable heavy prefill paths for long seqs, 2) lower prefill concurrency, 3) schedule KV compaction / rebalance. Who can apply quick config?
Jin (eng-runtime): I'll push a temporary config to reduce prefill concurrency and set seq threshold so requests >1024 skip prefill. Pushing now.
Jin (eng-runtime): Applying change via admin API:
```
POST /admin/configs/kv_prefill
{ "enabled": false, "seq_threshold": 1024 }
# curl example
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/configs/kv_prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"enabled":false,"seq_threshold":1024}'
```
ops-bot: Config rollout: kv_prefill change applied to shard-7, shard-8 (canary 2/4 nodes).
ops-bot: Eviction rate down ~60% since change at 2026-03-15T21:12:03Z. Memory pressure trending down.
Lisa (prod-support): Notifying impacted customers: two streaming customers and one internal partner experienced stalls. Drafted message to customer success for targeted outreach.
Maria (oncall): Good. Jin, please also add a decode-only fallback route for streaming so we can preserve availability while prefill is off.
Jin (eng-runtime): Adding fallback route now — will route streaming to model-variant-lite when seq > 1024 or when prefill queue depth > 50.
Alex (sre): Observed KV fragmentation metric remains elevated. We'll need offline compaction. I'm scheduling a compaction job at 21:30Z on low-traffic window; it'll run per-shard with rolling restarts for prefill-workers.
Jin (eng-runtime): Planning a rolling restart for prefill workers on shard-9 now to rebalance allocations. Doing one node at a time.
Maria (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing primary to Jin for the next 60m. I'll monitor but stepping out for brief. Jin, you're lead.
Jin (eng-runtime): Ack — taking lead. Updating incident channel and status. Will keep Maria posted.
ops-bot: p95/p99 snapshot after config change: p95 down from 1.2s -> 0.9s, p99 down from 12.4s -> 3.1s (20s since mitigation started). Streaming stall rate decreased by ~70%.
Maria (oncall): Nice improvement. Criteria to resolve: p99 < 2s and stalls < 1% for 30m. If not met, escalate to eng-runtime lead and consider temporary traffic routing to dedicated capacity pool.
Lisa (prod-support): Customer impact summary: 3 customers affected with streaming stalls 5-12s, intermittent errors for short generation jobs. CS notified and queued high-touch outreach for top-2 customers.
Alex (sre): Note — root cause likely interplay of KV fragmentation (many small segments) + sudden prefill throughput increase from a batch of long-context requests. Prefill created many small KV entries causing memory scatter and higher GC/eviction frequency. We'll include prefill size checks in safeguards.
Jin (eng-runtime): I'll add a guard to limit per-request prefill KV allocations and a soft rate limit on long-context prefill. Also scheduling a follow-up to rebalance shard allocation algorithm to reduce hot-spotting.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev2. Postmortem required. Assigned: eng-sre + eng-runtime.
Maria (oncall): Thanks everyone. Keep updates short. If p99 < 2s sustained for 30m, we'll resolve and document mitigations. If it resurfaces, open a new page and escalate.
Jin (eng-runtime): Will follow up with PRs for: 1) prefill-size guard, 2) routing fallback for long seqs, 3) compaction runbook additions.
Lisa (prod-support): I'll link customer tickets in the incident doc.
Alex (sre): Launching compaction job in 10m. Will post logs here and flag any node restarts.
ops-bot: Compaction kickoff: started on shard-7 node-3 at 2026-03-15T21:29:50Z.
Maria (oncall): Oncall status: handing off to Jin. I'll rejoin if needed. Good work team.
